title: heuchera hartwegii
intro: Heuchera hartwegii, commonly known as Coral Bells, is a species of flowering plant in the saxifrage family that is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Heuchera hartwegii include its ability to act as an analgesic and anti-inflammatory agent, as well as its potential to exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Heuchera hartwegii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
